mentions.name: AhDocs
mentions.description: AI-enabled document management system with PAdES-B-LTA compliant e-signature. Organizes documents around stakeholders (customers, vendors, employees), extracts insights per document, and lets users chat with documents individually, per stakeholder, per stakeholder type, or across the business. Includes a lightweight form builder, template support, document upload via phone camera, and email-in document ingestion.
mentions.audience: Businesses organizing documents around customers, vendors, and employees
mentions.source_excerpt: I recently soft-launched AhDocs (https://www.ahdocs.com). It is an AI-enabled document management system + PAdES compliant e-signature software (PAdES-B-LTA).
